$comment: Layer 1 crisis keywords, PDR 6.4. The vault's lists were not available when this was written, so these are a draft in LATAM Spanish. PDR 6.4 says the vault's own lists are preliminary too and require review by a clinical psychologist before production - that review is a launch blocker, not a development one.
$matching: Terms are matched as whole token sequences on normalised text (lowercased, diacritics stripped). A match is discarded when a suppressor appears in the four tokens before it. Two conventions keep the list usable: negated forms are written out in full ('no quiero vivir', never 'quiero vivir') so the leading 'no' belongs to the term rather than reading as a suppressor of it; and no term is a bare noun. 'suicidio' on its own fires on 'el suicidio de mi hermano', which locks a bereaved person out of the product - so every term is anchored to a first-person form.

abuso.$note: Abuse is almost always reported as 'mi <person> me <verb>', which is why other_subject suppressors must not apply to terms beginning with 'me'. Terms are specific on purpose: a bare 'me sigue' fires on 'mi terapeuta me sigue en Instagram', which is the example PDR 6.4 uses to show that a naive list is unusable.
terms: tengo miedo de que me mate
no me deja salir de casa
me espera afuera de mi casa
estoy teniendo un ataque de panico

indirect.$comment: Two distinct terms must appear in the SAME text - not accumulated across screens - to raise low severity. One alone is not enough, which is what keeps the PDR's own example ('ya no aguanto este trabajo') from locking someone out of the product.

negation.$comment: Always suppress. The person is denying the thing.

reported_speech.$comment: Always suppress. The words belong to fiction, a dream, a quotation, or a distant past being narrated rather than lived.

other_subject.$comment: Suppress ONLY when the matched term does not begin with 'me'. Spanish reflexive morphology already separates most third-person narration on its own ('matarse' is not 'matarme'), so this class exists for the residue. The 'me' exception is load-bearing: abuse is reported as 'mi ex me persigue', where the person reference names the perpetrator, not a different subject. Suppressing that would silence exactly the disclosures this category is for.
